sections.overview: Its range lies farther north than that of the Common Black Widow, Latrodectus mactans.
sections.identification: Females are glossy dark, with variable red spots on the upper abdomen.
sections.habitat: In Quebec, records are from a few southern localities.
sections.diet: It is a web-building predator; species-specific prey details are limited.
sections.behavior: A Quebec paper describes it as discreet and not inclined to bite.
sections.reproduction: A Quebec female with three egg sacs confirmed local reproduction.
sections.ecology: It is distinct from L. mactans and shares its genus with L. geometricus, L. hasselti and L. katipo.
sections.conservation: In 2021, four Quebec localities were known; this is not a global threat assessment.
